conditions.requirement: Embedding output_reduce_group and SP group use the same required ranks/order and per-rank token map; keep PCP/token exchange and different fine-grained branches.
Preserve masked original/added vocabulary ownership, local embedding primitive, valid IDs and invalid/padded rows.
SUM dtype/rounding/NaN/signed-zero contract and backend numerical equivalence for AllReduce-to-ReduceScatter.
Use true padded extent before ReduceScatter; more padding can offset payload reduction, especially tiny N.
Retain zero-pad rank slice, no-pad clone/custom-op functional alias rules and required contiguous output.
Original global mask values and generation preserved; hidden argument supplies N only, not mask truth values.
Local IDs and mask publication preserve all global input/query/position/slot/token-index outputs and rejection/anchor/DCP effects.
Initial same-value four-channel state and onehot FP32 premix apply only to the first of six HCpre stages per source-order pattern.
First-y bypass or coefficient prefold requires explicit finite/special-value/signed-zero/FP32/native reduction and BF16 rounding contract.
First HCpost and later residual readers still receive the full equivalent four-channel state; logical broadcast does not imply dead storage.
HCpre data-dependent coefficients and next pre_mix remain available; do not delete whole HCpre from a y shortcut.
Cross-boundary composition emits both state and ffn_pre/attn_pre, preserves residual lifetimes and last-layer collapse.
Input norm and existing RMSNormCast keep BF16 output and FP32 widening of rounded BF16, not unrounded norm substitution.
Wq_a/Wkv/norm/RoPE intended replicas, exact parameter versions and native math retained; declaration is not live equality attestation.
Exact CP start/num_actual/per_rank versus SP-owned row mapping, including FlashComm/DP suffix, known or explicitly routed.
Q_a1280 and KV512 output barriers/row plans/duplicates and Qnorm/quant/Q_b interface preserved when changing M/layout.
Keep global_metadata cache rows/positions/slots and required KV writes even on zero-query ranks.
Every required group participant, send/receive count, padding and uniform MC2/DP collective domain remains.
Keep local-zero padding, head AllToAll, suffix restore, grouped Wo_a/Wo_b and ReduceScatter contributions for all valid global tokens.
Preserve cache dtype/layout/negative skip/duplicate-write order and global current-query publication.
Context main_norm and query input_layernorm rows have separate values/epochs despite shared layer WKV; no same-position reuse assumption.
Same-layer joint WKV row pack preserves separate512norm/RoPE/slot metadata and changed-M numerical contract.
Lazy context schedule preserves context-before-query conflicting cache writes and required noncausal same-request readiness.
Preserve actual no-attn-metadata zero output and dummy/profile allocation/communication purposes; dummy ancestry is not startup-only.
No-SP/TP1/PCP/fine-grained/quantized-output/base nonCP/compressed roles remain separate domains from selected SWA CP path.
Padding math pruning needs proof of no live row observer and exact sentinel outputs, not shape or noQ count alone.
All captured/input/output/premix/residual bank addresses, strides, aliases, readiness and last-reader epochs preserved.
Cross-iteration keys include request/context-vs-query provenance/accepted-rollback/slot/position/weight/config generations.
Price new launches, packing, collectives, buffering and interference jointly; counts/logical bytes are not time or speedup.
Keep external hooks, all raw/local/global state observers and valid-row consumers unless independently closed.
